name: Portable Purple Clay Travel Quick-Cup
marketing_tip: Enjoy the rich flavor of Yixing Zisha wherever your journey takes you with this portable set.
body: Crafted from authentic purple clay, this travel-friendly set features a clever nesting design for easy transport. The porous nature of the Zisha clay seasons over time, enhancing the aroma and taste of your favorite Oolongs on the go.
original_title: 紫砂快客杯1壶4杯旅行功夫茶具便携套装户外泡茶装备私人定制礼品
